review_findings_addressed.finding: submit was a stub returning gated_pending_activation and never invoked target/evidence/size guards
review_findings_addressed.fix: pure prepare(args,targets,writes) is the single prevalidation path, called by submit; guards are reached and tested positively and negatively

review_findings_addressed.finding: PublishEvidence only called plan show and never wrote evidence
review_findings_addressed.fix: evidence write performed via the backend, then the WRITTEN FILE is read back and its digest compared; plan metadata is no longer the evidence

review_findings_addressed.finding: settled replay returned Error(replayed) regardless of saved outcome
review_findings_addressed.fix: typed Decision ReplaySaved(record) returns the saved record; a saved Uncertain re-surfaces as uncertain, never as success

review_findings_addressed.finding: andon_clear read a marker nothing wrote, and did not cover a crash after reservation
review_findings_addressed.fix: single CURRENT pointer per parent task, created or CAS-replaced via files.replace with the old digest, never deleted; a reservation with no settled result holds

review_findings_addressed.finding: a .released file would release all future uncertainties and its second create would fail
review_findings_addressed.fix: release file removed entirely; the hold is derived from the pointer plus the pointed-at result record

review_findings_addressed.finding: fence(0) reserved no window and post-fence ran after the success record was saved
review_findings_addressed.fix: fence widened to 25s covering dispatch and readback; post-fence runs BEFORE the settled record is saved
ledger records carry schema, key, parent_plan, parent_task and the exact canonical_payload alongside payload_sha256; validate_saved checks all of them

review_findings_addressed.finding: errors after reservation could read as refusals
review_findings_addressed.fix: andon_reserve, pointer_create, pointer_cas, reserve, post_fence, result_save, evidence_write all classify uncertain:

review_findings_addressed.finding: dispatch arm bypassed state.unresolved and never armed it
review_findings_addressed.fix: arm refuses when unresolved, and arms it on a.outcome_unknown or an uncertain: prefix; reads, status and reconcile stay usable

review_findings_addressed.finding: native names need >=2 lowercase slash segments and task_id was overloaded as name
review_findings_addressed.fix: normalize_name per sa_plan_name.ml:7,18; plan name derived from the allowlisted target, task name planning/<lowercased id>; validated pre-dispatch and compared normalized on readback
title_valid requires nonempty, <=4096 bytes, no NUL, before anything is reserved

review_findings_addressed.finding: readback assumed JSON stdout and a plan_id field
review_findings_addressed.fix: explicit --format json; exactly one JSON record line plus one known diagnostic line; exact id plus parent, name and title; ambiguous or unexpected output refused

review_findings_addressed.finding: guard test accepted missing-file and grant errors so proved nothing, and the backend left real grant/file reads in the path
review_findings_addressed.fix: guards and ledger/Andon decisions factored into pure functions the real path calls, driven by positive traces with no file, grant, clock or CLI access

review_findings_addressed.finding: prepare and decide_ledger were definitions only, never called, so the shared-path comments were false
review_findings_addressed.fix: submit_with now calls precheck, then authorized_targets, then prepare(args,targets,execution.scope.writes), then decide_ledger(saved,pending,...) and branches on ReplaySaved/Dispatch; the duplicated inline ledger logic is removed, so the tests cover the actual branches. Verified by grep: calls at planning_intents.gleam:324, :331 and :587.

review_findings_addressed.finding: ReplaySaved returned the saved Applied tag
review_findings_addressed.fix: a replay now reports typed outcome Replayed and carries the immutable original record plus its digest under original_record/original_sha256; the saved Applied record itself is never rewritten

review_findings_addressed.finding: fence(25s) ran BEFORE the bounded 15s risk phase, so risk could consume the backend window
review_findings_addressed.fix: fence(0) before risk, then a re-observed fence(25s) AFTER risk immediately before pointer and intent reservation and the two 10s backend calls; its clock is preserved and checked with clock.continuity against the final fence, as ops.effect does

review_findings_addressed.finding: the new ordering made no-IO refusals depend on reading the grant
review_findings_addressed.fix: precheck(args) runs structural key, intent and logical_id validation with no grant, file or clock access, before authorized_targets; prepare re-checks idempotently on the full path

review_findings_addressed.finding: submit_with fenced only Dispatch, so ReplaySaved bypassed expiry, current-owner and control checks
review_findings_addressed.fix: a.fence(execution,0) immediately after the pure precheck and BEFORE the grant and ledger reads, so a read-only replay carries current reviewed authority exactly as harness_read_file does; the post-risk 25s window remains for Dispatch only and its clock is still carried into clock.continuity

cross_process_andon.mechanism: planning.andon_guard derives the hold from the durable CURRENT pointer plus the pointed-at result record, so it does not depend on in-memory state and survives a fresh process, grant and attempt
cross_process_andon.verified_by: grep over the frozen source, independently confirmed by root
cross_process_andon.correction: an earlier revision of this artifact said NOT_IMPLEMENTED and claimed an admission-layer change was required. That was wrong: it conflated untested at runtime with missing in source. The guard is wired at both generic mutation entry points; what remains is runtime exercise, not implementation.
cross_process_andon.separate_limitation: legacy generic uncertainties unrelated to planning still rely on in-memory state.unresolved within one process; that is a distinct pre-existing limitation and is not what this entry describes
